headword: {日照時間|にっしょうじかん}
gloss: hours of sunshine; hours of daylight

definitions.gloss: hours of sunshine; hours of daylight
definitions.explanation: The length of time during which direct sunlight reaches the ground in a given day or period. A meteorological term also used in farming and real estate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日照時間|にっしょうじかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧。
examples.english: Today the hours of sunshine are short.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日照時間|にっしょうじかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In winter the hours of daylight decrease.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日照時間|にっしょうじかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧、⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: This region has long hours of sunshine, so vegetables grow well.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{日照|にっしょう}→日照：21173_nisshou⟧ ('sunshine') + ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ ('time'). A meteorological measure that is also relevant to farming, gardening, and real estate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日照時間|にっしょうじかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ / ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧: long / short hours of sunshine
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{日照時間|にっしょうじかん}: annual hours of sunshine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日当|ひあ}たり→日当たり：07498_hiatari⟧: sunlight exposure of a place — how much sun a particular spot receives
